about: C3 4th owner: phase b's balance, measured without rendering - from the river road's checkpoint, many tries by the bot's hands (src/scenes/tail/bot.js: 'aimer' and 'sloppy' aim like hands - the eye drifts round the mark, the press after a reaction; 'badsloppy' also drives badly), each try N.sim'd to its end (he is off the road, 'He warned them.', 'Lost him.', 'Wrecked.'). Prints per profile: wins, the outcomes, the seconds, shots and hits. Shot mode (?scene=tail&beat=river): a fail only stops the try. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_b_bench.json

steps.eval: (window.__ringAt = 999, window.__bench = async (profile, n, seed0 = 1) => { const res = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { window.__tailFails = []; G.scenes.go('tail', { beat: 'river', fade: 'cut', card: false }); const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; C.useBot(profile, { seed: seed0 + i * 17 }); C.autoBot = true; let end = null; const ring = []; const f = (v) => v ? [+v.pos.x.toFixed(0), +v.pos.z.toFixed(0), +v.speed.toFixed(0), +(v.yaw).toFixed(1)] : null; while (C.t < 75) { N.sim(0.5); { const P = C.driver.pilot; ring.push(`${C.t.toFixed(1)} his ${f(C.his)} pass ${P.passing||0} dodge ${(P.dodgeT||0).toFixed(1)} ahead ${P.ahead ? (P.ahead === C.my ? 'ME' : 'car') : '-'} want ${(P.want||0).toFixed(1)} back ${(P.backT||0).toFixed(1)} | me ${f(C.my)} | tr ${C.traffic.cars.map((c) => f(c.v) + (c.pilot.ahead ? (c.pilot.ahead === C.his ? 'H' : c.pilot.ahead === C.my ? 'M' : 'C') : '') + (c.aside > 0 ? 'a' : '') + (c.roundT > 0 ? 'r' : '') + (c.pilot.dodgeT > 0 ? 'd' : '')).join(' ')}`); if (ring.length > 160) ring.shift(); } if (C.failing) { end = (window.__tailFails.at(-1) || {}).why; break; } if (C.phase === 'crash' || C.phase === 'wreck' || C.phase === 'c') { end = 'WIN'; break; } } const H = C.hisDmg || {}; res.push({ end: end || 'time', t: +C.t.toFixed(1), s: C.gun.shots, h: C.gun.hits, ty: H.tyres || 0, nk: H.nicks || 0, m: H.man || 0, tk: H.tank || 0, b: H.body || 0, r: H.rims || 0, ram: C._ramWin ? 1 : 0, ctl: +C.driver.control.toFixed(2), dmg: +C.my.damage.toFixed(2), gap: +C.gap().toFixed(0), his: [+C.his.pos.x.toFixed(0), +C.his.pos.z.toFixed(0), +C.his.speed.toFixed(1)], my: [+C.my.pos.x.toFixed(0), +C.my.pos.z.toFixed(0), +C.my.speed.toFixed(1)], st: C.driver.state, ahead: C.driver.pilot && C.driver.pilot.ahead ? 1 : 0, stuck: C.driver.pilot ? +(C.driver.pilot.backT || 0).toFixed(1) : 0, ring: C.t >= window.__ringAt ? ring.filter((x, i) => i % 4 === 0) : null }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); } const wins = res.filter((r) => r.end === 'WIN'); const avg = (a) => a.length ? +(a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / a.length).toFixed(1) : null; return JSON.stringify({ profile, n, wins: wins.length, tWin: avg(wins.map((r) => r.t)), shots: avg(res.map((r) => r.s)), hits: avg(res.map((r) => r.h)), ends: res.reduce((o, r) => (o[r.end] = (o[r.end] || 0) + 1, o), {}), tries: res.map((r) => `${r.end[0]}${r.t}:${r.s}/${r.h} t${r.ty}n${r.nk}m${r.m}k${r.tk}b${r.b}r${r.r}${r.ram ? ' RAM' : ''}`).join(' '), odd: res.filter((r) => r.ring).map((r) => r.ring.join('\n')) }); }, 1)
